description: Edits a Kdenlive project file deterministically while staying aligned to stable visible surfaces such as track headers, the project profile title bar, and clearly visible timeline clip blocks.

actions.name: modify_project_xml
actions.description: Apply one or more XML operations to a .kdenlive project. Operations run in order and should stay aligned to stable visible outcomes such as renaming track headers, updating the project profile summary, or adding and removing timeline clip blocks.

operations.parent_xpath: XPath to the parent node for add_element
operations.tag: Element name to append for add_element

attributes.name: track or clip label
attributes.clip_id: existing clip id for a timeline clipref

examples.description: Add the existing Opening Title clip to the V2 timeline as a clearly visible block
Remove the existing V2 b-roll block from the timeline

done_action.description: Return this action when the task is fully complete.

tips: Use stable IDs like video_main, video_overlay, tl_intro, and tl_broll in XPath selectors.
Prefer stable visible surfaces: track headers, the project profile summary, and clearly visible timeline clip blocks.
Reuse existing visible clip IDs like clip_intro, clip_broll, and clip_title when adding timeline clipref entries.
Visible timeline outcomes are easiest to validate through track names plus timeline clip positions and durations.
Boolean-style flags in the project use 1 for enabled and 0 for disabled.
